items.source: Create a new RowMapperResultSetExtractor.
items.translation: 创建一个新的RowMapperResultSetExtractor。

items.source: Implementations must implement this method to process the entire ResultSet.
items.translation: 实现必须实现此方法来处理整个ResultSet。

items.source: rowMapper - the RowMapper which creates an object for each row, must not be null.
items.translation: rowMapper - 用于为每一行创建对象的 RowMapper 接口，不能为 null。

items.source: Note that a RowMapper object is typically stateless and thus reusable.
items.translation: 请注意，RowMapper 对象通常是无状态的，因此可以重复使用。

items.source:
Useful for the typical case of one object per row in the database table. The number of entries in the results will
match the number of rows.
items.translation: 适用于数据库表中每行一个对象的典型情况。结果中的条目数量将与行数相匹配。

items.source: extractData in interface ResultSetExtractor<T>
items.translation: 接口 ResultSetExtractor<T> 中的方法 extractData

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - if a DriverException is encountered getting column values or navigating (that is, there's no need to catch DriverException)
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 如果在获取列值或导航时遇到 DriverException（即无需捕获 DriverException）

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况

items.source: rowsExpected - the number of expected rows (just used for optimized collection handling).
items.translation: rowsExpected - 预期行数（仅用于优化集合处理）。

items.source:
an arbitrary result object, or null if none (the extractor will typically be stateful in the
        latter case).
items.translation: 任意结果对象，若无则返回 null（在后一种情况下，提取器通常是状态化的）。

items.source: Adapter implementation of the ResultSetExtractor interface that delegates to a RowMapper which is supposed to create an object for each row. Each object is added to the results List of this ResultSetExtractor.
items.translation: 这是 `ResultSetExtractor` 接口的适配器实现，它委托给一个 `RowMapper`（该映射器应为每一行创建一个对象）。每个创建的对象都会被添加到此 `ResultSetExtractor` 的结果列表中。
